scope: Proposition 2.4 of the manuscript “Uniform indices for semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs” (preprints/Uniform-indices-for-semi-log-canonical-log-Calabi-Yau-pairs-October-5-2026/uniform-slc-index.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 588f61707a03040f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix n. Let h : V → Y be a contraction over C, where V is klt of dimension n, KV ∼Q 0, and 0 < b = dim Y < n. Suppose that a smooth projective resolution of Y is rationally connected. Then Y is isomorphic in codimension one to a normal projective variety ˆ︁ Y in a bounded family depending only on n. In particular ˆ︁ Y has a very ample Cartier divisor H for which Hb ≤ Cn, |Kˆ︁ Y · Hb−1 | ≤ Cn. (2.2) The canonical intersection is the degree of the canonical Weil divisor on a general complete- intersection curve in the smooth locus.
